title: Literary Design of Ephesians 5:15-25
caption: <bp-cite>Ephesians 5:15-25</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Ephesians (2019).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group title="Three Contrasts" type="secondary">
      <group title="Contrast 1" type="bare">
        <group>
          <verse number="15" /> Therefore, watch carefully how y’all walk, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">not as unwise</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">but as wise</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="3">
          <verse number="16" /> redeeming the time, for the days are evil. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group title="Contrast 2" type="bare">
        <group>
          <verse number="17" /> Because of this, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">don’t be foolish</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">but discern what is the will of the Lord</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group title="Contrast 3" type="bare">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a''">
          <verse number="18" /> And <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">don’t be drunk with wine,</char> which is recklessness; 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b''">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">but be filled by the Spirit</char>, 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group title="Spirit Influences 1-4" indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="19" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">speaking</char> to each other in psalms, hymns, and spiritual poems, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">creating poems</char> and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">singing</char> in y’all’s hearts to the Lord, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="20" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">giving thanks</char> always to God the Father for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Messiah, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="21" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">submitting</char> to one another in reverence of the Messiah, 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group title="Two Concrete Examples of Mutual Submission" indent="2" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="22" /> wives to their husbands 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">as to the Lord</char>... 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="25" /> husbands, be loving your wives, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">as the Messiah loved the church</char> ... 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
